The '''Dressed Spinner''' is a [[tackle]] that helps [[fishing]] by reducing maximum delay before a nibble by 7.5 seconds (15 seconds if the player is using an [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] with 2 Dressed Spinners). It can be [[Crafting#Fishing|crafted]] or purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|1000}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 8]]. It can also be found in regular [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] (4% chance) after reaching Fishing level 6 and [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (9% chance).<ref name="chestchance" /> It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|500}} or obtained as a gift from [[Willy]] at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es and [[Golden Mystery Box]]es after reaching Fishing level 6.

One Dressed Spinner is the reward for completing the {{Bundle|Lake Fish|24|y}}. One Dressed Spinner is also one of the rewards the player gets the first time they win the fishing competition at the [[Festival of Ice]].
